verdict.rationale: The pack documents no export or bulk-retrieval capability for customer, alert, case or decision data. The closest evidence is listed external entity ID management (alloy-docs-24) and an entity-lookup API reference page. These give stable identifiers for entities but are building blocks, not an export feature, and say nothing about alerts, cases or decisions.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export customer, alert, case and decision data with stable identifiers for reconciliation
